added_failures_note: The pre-existing suite arm carries no added failure: tests/test_tracked_read.py passed 4 of 4 at base a1f6782 (logs/gate_tracked_read_base.log, EXIT=0) and 4 of 4 at head 0adcf5d6c (logs/gate_tracked_read_head.log, EXIT=0), and this window changes no nova/ source. The three ids above are the accuracy file's trial clauses, already red at the previous review head 2e007b43 and still red at 15f6cfdd (logs/accuracy_gate_head.log, head 8fae4af5d, '3 failed, 8 passed', EXIT=1); the reviewed manifest declares them deliberately under outside_scope as the reproduced trial-booking defect, and the delta adds none beyond them.

findings.text: the diverted trial row reports "axis, analytic field substituted" 3.88e-6 m and "interpolant's own distance" 1.88e-4 m, and the prose at line 59 rests the whole stage attribution on them, but no recorded run produced those two cells: the only log carrying analytic_field_axis_error_m is logs/accuracy_gate_limited.log, which ran with -k limited, and a grep of every log and of logs/tracked_read_h200_rows.json finds no diverted row of that shape, so the diverted half of the section's accuracy attribution is claimed rather than recorded.

the fragment says the behavioural clause "requires the read's cell and the field's cell to be the same index", but tests/test_tracked_read_accuracy.py:249 never calls support_read.read, so the sentence describes a guard the run does not have.

both sides of the assertion derive from one owner - located calls field._location, which calls nearest_cell - so it holds whatever nearest_cell returns and stays green if the read stops using the owner, which is the regression its name claims to catch.

the docstring says the wall polygon is swept for the coarse extremum "farthest from the axis flux" while line 109 takes argmin(|values - axis_flux|), the nearest; the code is right only while every wall flux lies below the axis flux, and the description hides that fragility from the next reader.

_wall_extremum and analytic_boundary duplicate wall-flux extremum selection owned by nova/geometry/select.py:165 host_wall_flux, which is independent of the read and could be called here rather than re-implemented.

a prototype measurement script imports _psi and analytic_boundary from tests.test_tracked_read_accuracy, which itself imports tests.equilibrium.test_topology_read._analytic_inputs, inverting the layering so the reference cannot be run outside a pytest-equipped tree.
